title: Plaid header
description: A floating, translucent white pill nav fixed near the top: a small capitals wordmark, evenly spaced links (some with chevrons) that take a faint white wash on hover, a periwinkle outline 'log in' and a near-black rainbow-rimmed CTA. On phones the pill shrinks to the mark and a menu button that opens a rounded panel. It fades and rises out of the way while scrolling down and comes back on scrolling up.
notes: position: fixed; the first block under it (the hero) leaves room for it
best over a coloured or gradient hero: the pill is translucent white
